checks_that_cannot_fail.reason: HB-: for a doubly symmetric section under a pure torque twist and bending are decoupled structurally, so bending/twist is 0 whatever K_sigma the code adds (the ADR records 0); it checks no spurious coupling only for this symmetric case and passes under Z1, Z2 and Z5.

HS compares the ratio of two resonances found by the same search with sqrt(3); it adds nothing beyond H2 for both signs (each within 1e-3) except a tighter limit, and cannot fail if both signs share the same error.

limits_that_test_nothing.reason: H2/H2T limit 1e-3 (also 264) is about 4000x the recorded 2.3e-7 and 7.2e-7 errors; only gross errors (the K_sigma mutations shift by 0.3 to 2) can trip it.
H1 limit 3e-5 against a compression value of 1.39e-8 (and an estimate of 3.5e-6 in tension) is 3 orders loose for one sign, so it cannot see small errors there.
H3 limit 1e-8 against recorded 7.1e-14 and 1.9e-12 is 4 to 6 orders loose for an eigenvalue-equality check.
H7 negative control only requires relative difference > 0.3 while the recorded values are 0.776 and 0.565; it only shows the option has a large effect.
